text: Riello UPS is the UPS brand of the Riello Elettronica Group; Riello Elettronica S.p.A. is the group's holding company, founded in 1986 by Pierantonio Riello, who has led the company ever since.
short: Riello UPS belongs to the founder-led Riello Elettronica group.

source.name: Riello Elettronica Group: About Us
source.quote: Founded in 1986 by Cav. Lav. Pierantonio Riello, who has successfully led the company ever since
